Over on Github,  my usual pattern of seeing something that might be interesting:

"Ohh there's finally someone making some software that does X. That's great!"

"Ohh that release is verrrrry recent, huh."

"Oh this is just ai slop"

There is suddenly so much garbage on github it is unreal. #aislop #github #vibecoding #softwareengineering
